cards.ex: The two companies are going head-to-head for market share.
cards.exUz: Ikkala kompaniya bozor ulushi uchun bellashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ikki tomonning bir-biriga qarshi kuch sinashishi, raqobatlashuvi.

cards.ex: They fought tooth and nail to win the contract.
cards.exUz: Ular shartnomani yutish uchun jon jahdi bilan kurashdilar.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun juda qattiq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: There's a heated rivalry between the two sports teams.
cards.exUz: Ikki sport jamoasi o'rtasida qizg'in raqobat bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va hissiyotga boy raqobat.

cards.ex: She really outdid herself with this presentation.
cards.exUz: Ushbu taqdimot bilan u o'zidan o'tib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining odatdagi qobiliyatidan ham yaxshiroq natijaga erishish.

cards.ex: He's known as a fierce competitor in the business world.
cards.exUz: U biznes olamida shiddatli raqobatchi sifatida tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun qattiq harakat qiladigan raqobatchi.

cards.ex: The campaign is finally gaining traction with voters.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya nihoyat saylovchilar orasida ommalashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanishni boshlash, mashhurlikka erishish.

cards.ex: Several athletes are still in contention for the gold medal.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta sportchilar hali ham oltin medal uchun da'vogar.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun imkoniyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Her work is a cut above the rest.
cards.exUz: Uning ishi boshqalardan ancha ustun.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga qaraganda sezilarli darajada yaxshiroq.

cards.ex: The new technology gives them a competitive edge.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya ularga raqobat ustunligini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatda ustunlik beradigan xususiyat.

cards.ex: The company is outpacing the competition in sales.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya sotuvlar bo'yicha raqobatdan o'zib ketmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatchilardan tezroq rivojlanmoq yoki yaxshiroq natijalarga erishmoq.

cards.ex: Their dinner parties are just displays of one-upmanship.
cards.exUz: Ularning kechki ovqatlari faqat o'zini ko'rsatishdan iborat.
cards.uzDef: Doimo boshqalardan ustun ekanligini ko'rsatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Her dogged determination helped her succeed.
cards.exUz: Uning qat'iyatliligi unga muvaffaqiyat qozonishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadiga erishish uchun qattiq harakat qilish, qat'iyatlilik.

cards.ex: We strive for excellence in everything we do.
cards.exUz: Biz har bir ishimizda mukammallikka intilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi natijalarga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He needs to raise his game if he wants to win.
cards.exUz: Agar g'alaba qozonmoqchi bo'lsa, u o'z o'yinini yaxshilashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z mahoratini yoki ish faoliyatini yaxshilash.

cards.ex: They were beaten neck and crop in the final match.
cards.exUz: Ular final o'yinida butunlay mag'lub bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: To'liq, butunlay yo'q qilish yoki ustunlik qilish.

cards.ex: The heat is on as the deadline approaches.
cards.exUz: Muddat yaqinlashgani sayin vaziyat qizidi.
cards.uzDef: Bosim kuchaygan, qiyin vaziyat.

cards.ex: They're in pole position to win the championship.
cards.exUz: Ular chempionatda g'alaba qozonish uchun yetakchi o'rinda.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi imkoniyatga ega bo'lish, oldinda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company is always ahead of the curve with its innovations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya innovatsiyalari bilan doimo tendentsiyadan oldinda.
cards.uzDef: Yangi tendentsiyalarni boshqalardan oldin qabul qilish.

cards.ex: It's a dogfight in the airline industry.
cards.exUz: Bu aviakompaniya sanoatida qizg'in kurash.
cards.uzDef: Juda qizg'in va shafqatsiz raqobat.

cards.ex: You need to stay one step ahead of the competition.
cards.exUz: Siz raqobatdan doimo bir qadam oldinda bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Doimo raqiblardan oldinda bo'lishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: After that blow, he was out for the count.
cards.exUz: O'sha zarbadan keyin u mag'lub bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Mag'lub bo'lgan, o'yindan chiqib ketgan.

cards.ex: That was a close call, we almost lost the game.
cards.exUz: Bu xavfli vaziyat edi, biz deyarli o'yinda mag'lub bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli, lekin muvaffaqiyatli hal qilingan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Their team is in a league of their own.
cards.exUz: Ularning jamoasi o'z darajasida.
cards.term: in a league of their own
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ancha yaxshiroq, o'ziga xos.

cards.ex: She decided to throw her hat in the ring for the presidency.
cards.exUz: U prezidentlik uchun kurashga qo'shilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tanlovda yoki raqobatda ishtirok etishga rozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company is on the ropes due to the economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya iqtisodiy tanazzul tufayli qiyin ahvolda.
cards.uzDef: Juda qiyin ahvolda bo'lish, mag'lubiyatga yaqin bo'lish.

cards.ex: Football is a game of inches, every play matters.
cards.exUz: Futbol - bu kichik farqlar o'yini, har bir harakat muhim.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba yoki mag'lubiyat kichik farqlarga bog'liq bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: He's the front runner in the mayoral election.
cards.exUz: U mer saylovida peshqadam.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonishga eng katta imkoniyati bor odam yoki guruh.

cards.ex: There's no love lost between the two politicians.
cards.exUz: Ikki siyosatchi o'rtasida sovuq munosabat mavjud.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro yoqtirmaslik, dushmanlik munosabatlari.

cards.ex: We need to clear the way for new ideas.
cards.exUz: Biz yangi g'oyalar uchun yo'l ochishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: To'siqlarni olib tashlash, imkoniyat yaratish.

cards.ex: He's a dark horse in the competition, but he could surprise everyone.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada kutilmagan g'olib bo'lishi mumkin, ammo u hammaga ajablanarli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan g'olib bo'lish imkoniyati bor odam.
